description: List messages that are still waiting to go out to customers: pending store notifications from Salla, Zid and WooCommerce (order updates, abandoned-cart reminders, …) and the outgoing WhatsApp send queue (including failed sends that would be re-sent when the number reconnects). Use it when the merchant asks "what is about to be sent?" or wants to stop pending messages. Returns totals per source and rows with source + source_id — pass those to cancel_scheduled_activity. Does NOT list bulk campaigns (use get_campaigns / cancel_campaign) or scheduled social posts (list_scheduled_social_posts). Read-only.

date_from.description: Only rows created on/after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Only rows created on/before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

phone.description: Only rows whose recipient phone STARTS with this (digits, e.g. "9665").

sources.description: Limit to these sources; omit for all. salla.notification / zid.notification / woo.notification = pending store notifications; message_queue = outgoing WhatsApp send queue.

name: list_scheduled_activity
